title: 摩根资管策略师：鲍威尔意外鹰派，市场加息预期升温
speaker: Tai Hui

segments.en: what would you say is the base case for the Fed not just this month but for the rest of the year then
segments.zh: 你认为美联储的基本情景是什么，不仅是本月，而是今年剩余时间？

segments.en: so our basic case remains the same that we think the Fed is going to be on hold obviously after the Jackson whole speech I think market pricing has changed quite a bit and we do recognize that the odds of a hike have increased
segments.zh: 我们的基本情景保持不变，认为美联储将按兵不动。但杰克逊霍尔演讲后，市场定价已明显变化，我们承认加息概率上升。

segments.en: I think for me Jackson whole speech was surprisingly revealing and I equally hawkish surprisingly revealing because we know that Kevin was doesn't believe in providing for guidance he was holding all the cards to his chest in June and July
segments.zh: 对我来说，杰克逊霍尔演讲出人意料地直白，而且同样鹰派。因为鲍威尔一向不喜欢前瞻指引，6月和7月他都按兵不动。

segments.en: so for him to be such a more forceful in sort of describing his current thinking about the economy and the monetary policy has been surprisingly revealing and I equally hawkish I think everybody read he says statement will say what that is indeed a pretty hawkish speech
segments.zh: 他如此有力地描述对经济和货币政策的看法，确实出人意料且鹰派。大家都认为这是一次相当鹰派的演讲。

segments.en: I actually ask this speaker to look into the statement word by word and tailor the hawkish remarks versus the dovish remarks and the AI tells me that ratio is five to one
segments.zh: 我让AI逐字分析演讲，鹰派言论与鸽派言论的比例是5比1。

segments.en: so for one dovish remarks they will five hawkish remarks and overall he's describing the economy performance as a stringent labor market at full employment financial conditions hardly restrictive and inflation is the biggest risk
segments.zh: 每一条鸽派言论对应五条鹰派言论。他描述经济为劳动力市场紧张、接近充分就业，金融条件并不紧缩，通胀是最大风险。

segments.en: and overall you know monetary policy has more work to do so I think the market is right to price a higher chance of hike into waste time
segments.zh: 总体而言，货币政策还有更多工作要做。因此市场提高加息概率的定价是合理的。
